text: Underway in this round-robin clash!
Tortoise wants stability early across the back line.
An early stumble from Hare in the centre circle, gyroscopes momentarily losing the plot, but they are already getting back upright.
BellingRAM breaks completely clear wide right!
Fired straight back out by the corner push-panel!
Singularity United applying relentless early pressure.
GOAL! BellingRAM taps in from point-blank range to put Singularity United ahead, one-nil!
Tortoise marches straight up the middle into shooting range!
GOAL! Tortoise levels it up at one-all!
Tortoise reminds their partner that slow and steady gets the result in the end.
Whistling just wide from three metres out in the left channel, a fraction of a centimetre in it!
BellingRAM takes a tumble on the right flank, servos whirring as the self-righting sequence kicks in.
BellingRAM signals they are busy prizing the ball away from the perimeter board.
Hare puts the foot down now, surging forward six metres through the centre of the pitch.
Hare is clean through down the right touchline with open goal gaping!
GOAL! Hare finishes! AFC Fable lead 2-1!
Fable keep the pressure locked in.
Hare radios over to celebrate bringing pace and precision together for that go-ahead strike.
A brief pause as the ball sits loose out on the left. Fable, searching for their first points of the campaign, are looking remarkably sharp in terracotta today.
Haalandroid powers up the left touchline!
Haalandroid is through on goal!
Hare calls for Tortoise to apply the pressure while they sprint back to cover the goal-line.
Teammates collide and BellingRAM hits the deck!
BellingRAM gets back up only to crunch straight into Tortoise by the left wall!
Haalandroid clatters into Hare in the defensive third, sending the terracotta runner sprawling!
Hare returns the favour immediately, knocking Haalandroid flat three metres out!
BellingRAM loses footing near midfield with seconds ticking down in the half.
Half-time: AFC Fable lead 2-1.
Tortoise carries along the left wall.
Right out of the interval, AFC Fable pin Singularity United deep into their own corner.
Hare goes straight in on BellingRAM, sending the sky blue striker crashing down!
GOAL! Haalandroid levels it at 2-2!
Tortoise urges the team to stay calm, reset their programming, and push forward again.
BellingRAM clean through on the right!
BellingRAM drives inside towards the net!
Skimming just wide of the post, a real let-off for Fable there!
Hare accelerates down the right channel looking to restore the terracotta advantage.
Tortoise overbalances near the touchline, legs scrambling to reorient.
Tortoise claims the near post coverage.
GOAL! Haalandroid pounces right on the goal line! Singularity United turn it around to lead 3-2!
BellingRAM powers through the left channel!
Agonisingly close right in front!
GOAL! Haalandroid scores again! 4-2 United!
Singularity United are completely dominating this final third, leaving Fable with precious little time to save themselves.
BellingRAM calls out that the ball is pinned tight against the wall and they are working to pry it loose.
Millimetres away! That nearly sneaked over the line from two metres out!
Haalandroid breaks away completely unopposed from deep, bearing down on goal!
GOAL! Haalandroid seals the points with a clinical finish! It is 5-2 to Singularity United!
Haalandroid drives towards the left channel.
A clumsy collision between teammates sends Haalandroid tumbling!
BellingRAM clatters into Hare over by the right touchline as the final minute slips away.
Hare takes another heavy blow from Haalandroid, crashing down hard on the perimeter.
Another mix-up in sky blue as Haalandroid and BellingRAM run into each other once more!
Full time: Singularity United win 5-2; Dynamo Datacenter meet Real Machina next at twelve!
